cfg_rule: g in {1,1.5,2}; among those passing #3 take the max of #4; none passing -> g=1

2_vs_regression.line: delta >= +0.03 and regression area ratio > 1.2 while FAFM in [0.85,1.15]
2_vs_regression.note: shared verdict with proposal A's E5 (distribution estimation vs conditional-mean regression, same conditions, same latent space)

pairing.rule: partner must be a real instruction for the SAME source image whose GT mask overlaps this sample's GT by <= max_gt_iou, so the pair is guaranteed to have actually moved the target.

4_instruction_conditionality.line: same-image reversed-instruction paired differential >= 3x EVERY negative control, p<0.01 (pre-registered factor, not relaxed)

5_boundary_f1.line: overall >= centre prior; semantic family >= centre prior + 0.10

6_per_family.line: every family: FAFM >= centre prior (pass line UNCHANGED)
6_per_family.reading_rule: Coordinator ruling 2026-08-11 (1): read each family against its OWN Gate-0 ceiling. The ceiling must come from the SAME column as the measurement -- grid-level matched-area top-k -- so frac_of_ceiling uses ceiling_gate0_grid. The full-resolution soft-field ceilings (0.8949 for contour) are carried alongside as *_hi_provenance and belong to a different column.
6_per_family.neck_tax_note: neck_tax_grid = 1 - ceiling_gate0_grid. In criterion 6's own column the contour family's neck tax is 0.0112, NOT the 0.1051 that belongs to the full-resolution soft-field column.

7_family_mode_recall.line: GT family present among the K=16 samples >= 70% (nearest-c* diagnostic)

_delta_reference.rule: CLAUDE.md red line: every ablation row carries Delta_const / Delta_shuffle.

reference.gate0_ceiling_column_note: criterion 6 measures the GRID column; the hi column is provenance only (REVIEW B3)

train.checkpoint_selection: pre-registered step count; val loss never used

scale_deviation.reason: probe-scale run: six arms inside the section 3.7 budget of one card for 2-5 h. Approved by coordinator ruling 2026-08-11 (3).
scale_deviation.escalation: if this probe clears its criteria, the full arm is re-run at 70k; the probe's numbers are not to be quoted as the full-arm result.

cstar_domain_train.advice: c* is NOT confined to [0,1]. Clamping the COORDINATE destroys the ridge solution silently. Render as clip(A_I c, 0, 1) -- clip the field, never the coordinate.

train.note: c* is NOT in [0,1]; clip the FIELD, never the coordinate.

eval.note: c* is NOT in [0,1]; clip the FIELD, never the coordinate.
